definition: Power distance: the hierarchical distance reflected in dialogue · high power distance uses the imperative · low power distance uses banter
core_finding: Tang Sanzang to Wukong is high power distance (imperative) · Wukong to Bajie is low power distance (banter) · quantifying the evolution of master-disciple closeness

dialogue_pairs.speaker: Tang Sanzang

representative_dialogues.tang_monk_speech: You monkey, how utterly outrageous! So fierce and stubborn — you are no disciple of mine; be off with you!

representative_dialogues.context: Thrice beating the White Bone Demon
representative_dialogues.tang_monk_speech: You monkey, this is plainly murder! I will not keep you as my disciple; be off with you!

representative_dialogues.context: Rescuing the king of Wuji Kingdom
representative_dialogues.tang_monk_speech: Wukong, be careful and do not take his life.
Wukong, do you say it is a demon?

dialogue_pairs.evolution_pattern: 10→9→6→4 · power distance gradually declines · master-disciple relationship grows close

dialogue_pairs.speaker: Sun Wukong

representative_dialogues.wukong_speech: Idiot, do you recognize old Sun?
Bajie, you lazy idiot! Go scout the mountain at once!
Idiot, don't cry! Master has been captured by demons — we must rescue him!

representative_dialogues.context: The great battle at Lion-Camel Ridge
representative_dialogues.wukong_speech: Bajie, you idiot, caught again? Watch old Sun come to your rescue!

dialogue_pairs.evolution_pattern: 3→4→2→3 · low power distance · brotherly banter predominates

dialogue_pairs.speaker: Sun Wukong
dialogue_pairs.relationship: Disciple to master · disciple to master

representative_dialogues.wukong_speech: Master, I meant well — you should not judge me so harshly!

representative_dialogues.context: Thrice beating the White Bone Demon · expelled
representative_dialogues.wukong_speech: Master, I will go back then — but do not recite that Golden Hoop Mantra!

representative_dialogues.context: Before the true and false Monkey Kings
representative_dialogues.wukong_speech: Master, I have not taken life — why do you drive me away again?
Master, these two princes have a karmic affinity — you may take them as disciples.

dialogue_pairs.evolution_pattern: 2→3→2→1 · Wukong's power distance to the Tang Monk stays low · deference predominates

dialogue_pairs.speaker: Zhu Bajie
dialogue_pairs.relationship: Junior to senior · junior to senior

representative_dialogues.bajie_speech: You Bimawen, the monkey who once wrecked the Heavenly Palace!

representative_dialogues.context: The Red Boy incident · Wukong is burned

representative_dialogues.bajie_speech: Brother, you've died in there! Let's disband!

dialogue_pairs.evolution_pattern: 1→6→4→3 · from provocation to honorific · power distance rises then falls

dialogue_pairs.speaker: Sha Wujing
dialogue_pairs.relationship: Junior to seniors · junior to seniors

representative_dialogues.shaseng_speech: Brother, I beg you to save me!

representative_dialogues.context: Thrice beating the White Bone Demon
representative_dialogues.shaseng_speech: Elder brother, Master is right — do be patient.
Elder brother, you go on — I will persuade Master.

dialogue_pairs.evolution_pattern: 7→5→4 · Sha Wujing's power distance to his seniors gradually declines · but deference remains

power_distance_insights: Tang Sanzang to Wukong has the highest power distance (8/10) · imperative predominates
Wukong to Bajie has low power distance (3/10) · banter predominates
Wukong to the Tang Monk has the lowest power distance (3/10) · deference predominates · yet equal
Bajie to Wukong moves from provocation (1) to honorific (6) · power distance rises then falls
Sha Wujing to his seniors has medium power distance (5/10) · politeness predominates
Power-distance evolution reflects master-disciple closeness: Tang Sanzang→Wukong gradually warms · Wukong→Bajie stays close
ISFJ Sha Wujing is most polite · ENTP Wukong is most bantering · INFJ Tang Sanzang is most imperative · ESFP Bajie is most changeable

linguistic_strategy_by_mbti.INFJ_Tang Sanzang: 命令式·文言化·说教式（高权力距离）
linguistic_strategy_by_mbti.ENTP_Wukong: 调侃式·市井口语·灵活切换（低权力距离）
linguistic_strategy_by_mbti.ESFP_Bajie: 反复式·撒娇式·情绪化（权力距离波动）
linguistic_strategy_by_mbti.ISFJ_Wujing: 礼貌式·文言·温和（中等权力距离）
